## Anomalies, Alerts, and Deployment
Automated alerts notify stakeholders via SMS, webhooks, or email when predefined thresholds (e.g., earnings surprises, short squeezes, or abnormal traffic spikes) are breached. Standard deployment timelines for full analytics infrastructure are 14 days, with high-priority data onboarding achievable within 72 hours.

- **n8n & Agent Scout**: Neural process mapping to detect and resolve operational inefficiencies.  
- **Self-Healing Workflows**: Automatic detection and repair of API or integration failures.
